_comment: Manual corrections applied by pipeline/build.py on top of data/raw.json. Actions: 'remove' (drop raw records), 'set' (override fields on matched raw records; optional start_was pins one of several statements), 'add' (insert a record missing from Wikidata), 'ack' (acknowledge a report flag as legitimate). Every entry should carry a source or reason.
